page.content:
High-shouldered Morrison sauropod with longer forelimbs than hind.

How Brachiosaurus connects

  • Topic: Sauropoda — Brachiosaurus is a high-shouldered Morrison sauropod.
  • Location: Morrison Formation — Brachiosaurus was described from Morrison rocks of Colorado.

What is Brachiosaurus?

Brachiosaurus altithorax browsed higher than diplodocids. Its Giraffatitan African relatives later filled museum halls under a related name.

Key threads lead to Sauropoda and Morrison Formation.
